section.heading: Getting Started with FlowForceRM GymRM
section.intro: Everything you need to know before you log in for the first time.

chapter.heading: What is FlowForceRM GymRM?
chapter.body: FlowForceRM GymRM is the official management system of FlowForceRM. It tracks all members, class schedules, payments, and attendance in one place — accessible from any device with an internet connection. No installation required. It works through any web browser such as Google Chrome or Safari.

role-item.name: Admin
role-item.description: Manages all members, schedules, revenue, memberships, and system settings. Full access to everything.

role-item.name: Coach
role-item.description: Views today's class schedule and the list of athletes booked into their assigned classes.

role-item.name: Staff / Front Desk
role-item.description: Looks up members by ID number and checks them in to class using the kiosk screen.

role-item.name: Athlete (Member)
role-item.description: Views personal profile, checks the class schedule, books classes, and monitors their subscription.

chapter.heading: How to Open the App
chapter.intro: GymRM is a website. You access it using any web browser on any device.

steps.step: Open your web browser. On Android phones, this is usually Google Chrome. On iPhones, it is Safari.
Type the gym's web address in the address bar at the top and press Go or Enter.
The FlowForceRM login page will appear with the logo and a Sign In form.

chapter.tip: Save the address as a bookmark or add it to your phone's home screen so you can open it with one tap.

screenshot.caption: Login page on an Android phone

chapter.heading: How to Log In

steps.step: On the login page, tap or click the Email field and type your email address.
Tap or click the Password field and type your password. Characters appear as dots for privacy.
Tap the blue Sign In button.
You will be taken to your dashboard based on your role (Admin, Coach, Staff, or Athlete).

chapter.warning: If you see "Invalid email or password," check that your CAPS LOCK is off. Passwords are case-sensitive.

chapter.heading: Forgot Your Password?

steps.step: On the login page, tap Forgot password? (found above the password field).
Enter your email address and tap Send Reset Link.
Check your email inbox for a reset link from FlowForceRM.
Tap the link in the email and follow the instructions to create a new password.

chapter.tip: Check your Spam or Junk folder if you do not see the email. If still missing after 5 minutes, contact the front desk.

chapter.heading: Finding Your Way Around
chapter.intro: After logging in, a sidebar menu appears on the left. On phones, it may appear as a menu icon at the top.

item.label: Dashboard
item.description: Your main overview – shows today's activity at a glance.

item.label: Athletes
item.description: Full list of all gym members. Admin and Staff only.

item.label: Schedule
item.description: Weekly class calendar – view, add, or manage classes.

item.label: Reports
item.description: Revenue reports and member statistics. Admin only.

item.label: Memberships
item.description: View and manage membership plan types and pricing.

item.label: Communications
item.description: Send SMS or notifications to members.

item.label: Settings
item.description: Change your account password or email.

chapter.tip: To log out: click your name at the bottom-left of the sidebar, then choose Sign Out.

section.heading: Admin Guide
section.intro: For gym managers and administrators who have full access to all features.

chapter.heading: 1. Dashboard – Your Daily Overview
chapter.intro: The Dashboard shows a quick summary of what is happening at the gym today.

box.label: Total Members
box.description: Total number of athletes registered in the system.

box.label: Today's Check-ins
box.description: How many athletes have checked in to class so far today.

box.label: Revenue This Month
box.description: Total payments collected in the current month, in Philippine Pesos.

box.label: Overdue Payments
box.description: Number of members with unpaid dues. Click to view them.

sections-visible.item: Recent Check-ins – Athletes who checked in recently, with time.
Recent Members – Newly registered athletes with their join date.
Expiring Soon – Members whose subscriptions are about to expire.

chapter.tip: Check the dashboard every morning to review overdue payments, expiring memberships, and inactive members.

chapter.heading: 2. Managing Athletes (Members)
chapter.intro: The Athletes page is where you manage all gym members — add new ones, update their information, view subscriptions, and check their history.

steps.step: Click Athletes in the left sidebar menu.
Use the search bar at the top to type a name, member number, or email address.
The list filters automatically as you type.
Click View on any athlete's row to open their full profile.

procedure.heading: How to Add a New Athlete

steps.step: Click Add Athlete on the Athletes page (top right).
Fill in: First name, Last name, Email, Contact number, Birthday, Emergency contact.
Click Save. The athlete will receive an email to set up their app account.

column.name: Athlete
column.description: Name and member ID number (e.g., NS-00001).

column.name: Status
column.description: ACTIVE = currently enrolled. INACTIVE = no active membership.

column.name: Subscriptions
column.description: Current membership plan and days remaining.

column.name: Joined
column.description: Date they first registered at the gym.

column.name: App Activated
column.description: Active = app login set up. Pending = not yet activated.

column.name: Last Check-in
column.description: When they last attended a class.

chapter.heading: 3. Schedule Management
chapter.intro: The Schedule page shows all classes for the week in a calendar view. Each colored block is a class.

steps.step: Click Schedule in the sidebar.
Find the class and click its colored block.
A popup shows booked athletes, coach, location, and capacity.

procedure.heading: How to Add a New Class

steps.step: Click Add at the top right of the Schedule page.
Select the class type (Boxing, Judo, BJJ, etc.).
Choose the day, start time, and end time.
Set the maximum number of athletes allowed.
Choose if this is a one-time or recurring weekly class.
Click Save. The class appears on the calendar.

procedure.heading: How to Cancel or Delete a Class

steps.step: Click the class block you want to remove.
In the popup, click the Delete (trash) icon.
Choose to cancel just this occurrence or the entire recurring series.

procedure.warning: If athletes are booked into the class, notify them through Communications before deleting.

chapter.heading: 4. Reports and Revenue
chapter.intro: The Reports page gives a financial and attendance overview of the gym.

item.name: Total Members
item.description: Grand total of all members in the system.

item.name: Daily Revenue
item.description: Payments received on a specific date. Shows member name, plan, amount, and payment method.

item.name: Monthly Revenue
item.description: Total collected in a specific month with all transaction details.

item.name: New Members Chart
item.description: Bar chart showing new members joined in the last few months.

item.name: Daily Check-ins Chart
item.description: Bar chart showing daily attendance over the past week.

procedure.heading: How to View Revenue for a Specific Date

steps.step: Click Reports in the sidebar.
In the Daily Revenue section, click the calendar icon to pick a date.
The table shows all payments received on that day.
Click CSV or PDF to download the data.

screenshot.caption: Reports page showing revenue and attendance data

chapter.heading: 5. Membership Plans
chapter.intro: Manage the different membership types and programs offered at the gym.

plan-card-info.item: Plan Name (e.g., Annual Membership, Boxing, Judo, BJJ)
Price – how much the plan costs
Subscribers – how many members are currently enrolled

chapter.tip: Click the pencil (edit) icon on any membership card to update its name, price, description, or settings.

chapter.heading: 6. Communications
chapter.intro: Send SMS messages or push notifications to members directly from GymRM.

steps.step: Click Communications in the sidebar.
Choose recipients: All Members, a specific group, or individual athletes.
Type your message in the text box.
Click Send. Members receive the message on their mobile phones.

chapter.tip: Use for class cancellations, payment reminders, special events, or gym announcements. Keep messages short and clear.

chapter.heading: 7. Settings
chapter.intro: Update your admin account email and password.

steps.step: Click Settings in the sidebar.
Under Web or App, type your current password.
Type your new password and confirm it in the third field.
Click Update Account Password.

chapter.warning: Use a mix of letters and numbers. At least 8 characters. Do not share your password.

section.heading: Coach Guide
section.intro: For FlowForceRM coaches who need to view their classes and check who is coming in today.

chapter.heading: 1. Your Dashboard – Today's Classes
chapter.intro: When you log in as a Coach, you see only the classes assigned to you for today.

class-card-info.item: Check-in status – green checkmark appears next to checked-in athletes

chapter.tip: No classes showing? It means no classes are scheduled for you today, or classes have not been added. Contact the admin.

screenshot.caption: Coach dashboard showing today's classes on desktop

chapter.heading: 2. Seeing Who Is in Your Class

steps.step: Look at the class card for your session.
Names of booked athletes are listed below the class time with initials shown as circles.
Athletes who checked in show a green checkmark (✓ In) next to their name.
Athletes who have not yet arrived appear without the green label.

chapter.note: The list updates in real time. No need to refresh the page.

steps.step: Click Schedule in the left sidebar.
The weekly calendar shows all gym classes.
Use the arrow buttons to navigate to next or previous weeks.
Click any class block to see details: time, booked athletes, and capacity.

section.heading: Staff and Front Desk Guide
section.intro: For front desk staff who check in athletes and look up member information.

chapter.heading: 1. Checking In an Athlete – Kiosk Screen
chapter.intro: The Kiosk is a check-in screen for the front desk. Athletes enter their member number on the number pad, or staff can scan their QR code.

steps.step: Open the Kiosk page. The screen shows a number pad and "Scanner Ready" message.
The athlete tells you their member number (format: NS-00001). Type it on the number pad, or scan their QR code.
Tap the OK button.
The athlete's name, photo, and today's available classes appear on screen.
Select the class the athlete is attending (e.g., Judo 10:00 AM).
Tap Check In. A confirmation message appears and the check-in is recorded.

chapter.warning: Member not found? Check for typos in the member number. New members not yet registered must see the admin first.
Inactive membership? The system will show a warning. Check with admin before allowing entry.

screenshot.caption: Kiosk check-in screen with number pad
Member details shown after entering ID

chapter.heading: 2. Looking Up a Member

steps.step: In the Kiosk screen, enter the member's ID or scan their QR code.
The member's profile card appears: name, photo, subscription status, and sessions remaining.
Check if membership is active or expired at a glance.

chapter.tip: No member number? Ask them to show their app profile where the NS number is displayed, or search by name in the Athletes page.

section.heading: Athlete Guide
section.intro: For members who want to view their profile, check the schedule, and book classes.

chapter.heading: 1. Setting Up Your Account
chapter.intro: When you join FlowForceRM, gym staff will register you in the system. You will receive an email to set up your app account.

steps.step: Check your email for a message from FlowForceRM with the subject "Activate your GymRM account."
Tap the link in the email. It will open GymRM and ask you to create a password.
Type a password you can remember. Tap Save.
Your account is active. Log in with your email and new password.

chapter.tip: Did not receive the email? Check Spam or Junk folder. Still missing? Ask the front desk to resend the activation link.

chapter.heading: 2. Your Profile
chapter.intro: Your profile page shows all personal information the gym has on file, plus your member card and number.

profile-info.item: Member number (e.g., NS-00042) – use this to check in at the front desk
QR Code – scannable code for quick check-in
Personal details: name, birthday, contact number, emergency contact
Subscription: current membership plan and days or sessions remaining

steps.step: Tap Schedule in the menu.
The weekly calendar shows all available classes. Each color is a different class type.
Use the Day or Week toggle to switch views. Day view is easier on smaller phone screens.
Tap any class block to see details: coach, location, available spots.

screenshot.caption: Class schedule as seen by a member

chapter.heading: 4. Booking a Class

steps.step: Go to Schedule and find the class you want.
Tap the class block to open its details.
Tap Book or the + button.
Confirmation message appears: "You have successfully booked this class."
The class now shows in your schedule with a Booked label.

chapter.warning: Class is full? The Book button is disabled. Try a different session or ask admin to add capacity.
chapter.tip: To cancel a booking, tap the class in your schedule and select Cancel Booking. Do this early so others can take your spot.

chapter.heading: 5. Your Membership and Subscription

subscription-statuses.status: Membership is current. You can attend classes.
Membership ends within 30 days. Time to renew.
Membership has ended. Contact front desk to renew before attending class.

type.name: Annual Membership
type.description: Valid for one full year. Unlimited classes within that period.

type.name: Session-based
type.description: Fixed number of class visits. Each check-in uses one session.

type.name: Monthly
type.description: Access to classes for one calendar month.

chapter.note: Memberships do not renew automatically. Contact the front desk when yours expires.

chapter.heading: 6. Checking In to Class

steps.step: Go to the front desk or kiosk screen upon arrival.
Tell the staff your member number (e.g., NS-00042) or show your QR code from the app.
Staff enter your number or scan your QR code. Your name and today's classes appear on screen.
Confirm which class you are attending. Staff taps Check In.
Confirmation appears. You are now checked in. Enjoy your training!

chapter.tip: Self check-in: At some locations, type your member number on the kiosk number pad and tap OK. Follow on-screen instructions.
